completable-future-concept.title: Compose asynchronous work with CompletableFuture
completable-future-concept.short: Build dependent asynchronous stages without blocking each step
completable-future-concept.summary: CompletableFuture represents a result that can be completed later and provides methods for composing dependent stages.
completable-future-concept.why: Chaining stages makes dependencies and error propagation explicit without manually coordinating callbacks and shared state.
completable-future-concept.tips: Choose async variants deliberately and provide an Executor when the common pool is not appropriate.

primitive-streams-concept.title: Use primitive streams for numeric pipelines
primitive-streams-concept.short: Process int, long, and double values without boxing each element
primitive-streams-concept.summary: IntStream, LongStream, and DoubleStream provide stream operations specialized for primitive numeric values.
primitive-streams-concept.why: They avoid repeated boxing and expose numeric operations such as sum, average, and range.
primitive-streams-concept.tips: Convert with boxed only when an object Stream or collection is actually needed.

map-copy-of.title: Create an unmodifiable map snapshot with Map.copyOf
map-copy-of.short: Copy mappings into an unmodifiable Map
map-copy-of.summary: Map.copyOf creates an unmodifiable map containing the mappings of another map.
map-copy-of.why: It is useful at API boundaries when callers should not mutate the returned mapping through the new reference.
map-copy-of.tips: Null keys and values are rejected, and the result is only a shallow copy of contained objects.

stream-iterate-predicate.title: Generate bounded streams with Stream.iterate
stream-iterate-predicate.short: Stop an iterative stream with a predicate
stream-iterate-predicate.summary: The three-argument Stream.iterate generates successive values while a hasNext predicate remains true.
stream-iterate-predicate.why: It expresses finite iterative sequences without combining an infinite stream with a separate limiting operation.
stream-iterate-predicate.tips: Make sure the next function progresses toward making the predicate false.

completion-exception.title: CompletionException
completion-exception.short: Inspect failures reported by asynchronous completion
completion-exception.summary: CompletionException wraps an exception that caused a completion stage or related computation to fail.
completion-exception.why: Methods such as CompletableFuture.join can report an asynchronous failure through this unchecked wrapper.
completion-exception.tips: Inspect getCause to handle the original failure and avoid discarding its diagnostic information.

closed-file-system-exception.title: ClosedFileSystemException
closed-file-system-exception.short: Do not use a file system after it has been closed
closed-file-system-exception.summary: ClosedFileSystemException indicates an operation was attempted on a FileSystem that is no longer open.
closed-file-system-exception.why: Paths and providers associated with explicitly managed file systems may depend on that file system's lifetime.
closed-file-system-exception.tips: Keep resource lifetime clear and close custom file systems only after all dependent work has finished.

var-compound-declaration-error.title: var cannot declare multiple variables at once
var-compound-declaration-error.short: Split inferred local variables into separate declarations
var-compound-declaration-error.summary: A local variable declaration using var must declare exactly one variable.
var-compound-declaration-error.why: Local variable type inference is defined from the initializer of one declarator, so compound declarations are not permitted.
var-compound-declaration-error.tips: Write one var declaration per local variable or use an explicit type where a compound declaration is clearer.

lambda-var-mixed-parameters-error.title: Do not mix var and implicit lambda parameters
lambda-var-mixed-parameters-error.short: Use var on every lambda parameter or none of them
lambda-var-mixed-parameters-error.summary: When var is used in a lambda parameter list, every parameter in that list must use var.
lambda-var-mixed-parameters-error.why: Java requires a consistent parameter declaration form within one lambda expression.
lambda-var-mixed-parameters-error.tips: Use var consistently when parameter annotations need it; otherwise omit var from all parameters.

unchecked-conversion-warning.title: Unchecked conversion warning
unchecked-conversion-warning.short: Keep generic type information instead of assigning raw values
unchecked-conversion-warning.summary: An unchecked conversion warning appears when a raw or insufficiently typed value is assigned to a parameterized type without a verifiable runtime check.
unchecked-conversion-warning.why: Type erasure prevents the compiler from proving that all elements satisfy the requested generic type.
unchecked-conversion-warning.tips: Remove raw types at their source and use properly parameterized APIs rather than suppressing the warning broadly.

arrays-as-list-primitive-array-trap.title: Arrays.asList treats a primitive array as one element
arrays-as-list-primitive-array-trap.short: A primitive array does not expand into a List of boxed values
arrays-as-list-primitive-array-trap.summary: Passing an int[] to Arrays.asList produces a List<int[]> containing the entire array as one element.
arrays-as-list-primitive-array-trap.why: The generic varargs parameter accepts reference types, and int[] itself is one reference value rather than an array of Integer objects.
arrays-as-list-primitive-array-trap.tips: Use a primitive stream and box its elements when a List<Integer> is required.
